Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: HuberScale.RobustResidual is the current default (huberK * 1.4826 * MAD); Absolute remains explicit. Line-search exhaustion now records levelStalled and excludes it from converged unless the remaining step is below tolerance. The scale/control/parity suites and independent landing evidence exist. Current candidate projection still shows a historical pending phase.

Fresh context: Yes: implemented repair / acceptance audit.

Next action: Reconcile bounded source/test/landing/candidate evidence and this ticket's exact criteria; retain intentional absolute-mode parity and degeneracy limits. Do not start another Huber implementation or infer wholesale motion migration from this repair.

Evidence: MotionControl.scala; MotionEstimator.scala; MotionHuberScaleSuite.scala; landing note 2026-10-01; live candidate projection.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Found in independent review of the scale-invariant motion solve (bd-01KXYJPWYV08VFWRMCYYDPZCAV, commit on branch motion/scale-invariant-solve-20260930). MotionControl huberK = 1.5 is in absolute intensity units (used in MotionEstimator robust weights), so the robust estimator is not intensity-scale invariant: reviewer probe with 0.6/1.4-voxel shifts found rz 0.0189 vs 0.0345 (clean, scale 1 vs 1e3), tx 0.776 vs 0.748 (noisy), tx 1.424 vs 1.321 (large shift). Scope: define huberK relative to a declared residual scale (e.g. MAD of residuals within the mask, per level/iteration or per frame), document the estimand change, add intensity-scale invariance tests with Huber active (scales 1e-6..1e6), and re-run VolreggerParitySuite; decide whether parity with volregger (absolute threshold) must be preserved or deliberately migrated. Also: 'if !accepted then levelConverged = true' reports a line-search failure after 6 halvings as convergence; decide and test. The robust-template MAD floor 1e-12 (MotionEstimator robust template) is in cost units and matters only at very low intensities.
